task.title: Installing the Quay Bridge Operator on OpenShift Container Platform
task.shortdesc: To enable the Quay Bridge Operator to synchronize your OpenShift Container Platform registry with Red Hat Quay, you can install the operator from OperatorHub in the OpenShift Container Platform web console.

ul.li: You have configured Red Hat Quay and obtained an OAuth access token.
You are logged in to OpenShift Container Platform as a user with administrative privileges.

note.p: The Quay Bridge Operator integrates OpenShift Container Platform resources, such as ImageStreams, with Red Hat Quay. It does not replace the OpenShift Container Platform internal image registry. Do not remove or disable the internal image registry, even after installing the Quay Bridge Operator.

step.cmd: Open the Administrator perspective of the web console and navigate to Operators → OperatorHub on the navigation pane.
Search for Quay Bridge Operator, click the Quay Bridge Operator title, and then click Install.
Select the version to install, for example, stable-3.18, and then click Install.

Click View Operator when the installation finishes to go to the Quay Bridge Operator’s Details page. Alternatively, you can click Installed Operators → Red Hat Quay Bridge Operator to go to the Details page.
